findings.title: A PR body edit re-reports three required contexts as SKIPPED at the same head, over their real verdict
findings.claim: On every `pull_request: edited` event governance.yml's `if:` guard makes policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script (3 of the 16 required contexts) create a new `skipped` check run at the unchanged head SHA; 3 of the 15 PRs merged since the guard landed merged with those 3 contexts' latest run `skipped` over an earlier real verdict, so a red policy-docs followed by a body edit is plausibly merge-eligible.
findings.mechanism: GitHub reports a job skipped by `if:` as passing a required check (docs, 'Handling skipped but required checks'; governance.yml's own on: comment relies on it). The body edit changes no commit, so the skipped run sits at the same SHA as the synchronize run's verdict. If the ruleset reads the latest run per context name, a failure is replaced by a pass-equivalent. No red has been masked yet in the window (masked_red_heads=0); the latest-wins hop was not probed live (brief forbids live perturbation), hence provisional.

findings.title: CODEOWNERS' required-check surface omits 14 verdict-bearing files, tests/run.sh among them
findings.claim: Deriving the required-check enforcement surface with the executed-in-any-form rule plus imports and read data finds 51 files, 14 of which no CODEOWNERS owner pattern matches, so a change to them merges on the hpo-approver App's review alone.
findings.mechanism: CODEOWNERS says the surface is derived as the scripts the workflows' non-comment lines execute and points to round6 codeowners_gap.py, whose EXEC regex only matches `<interpreter> <path>`. That misses `./tests/run.sh` (the `fast (3.14)` gate itself), `./tests/derive_closures.sh`, and `tools/audit/w5-partition/coverage_tree.sh`. It also stops at the entry script: counts.mjs (checkCounts, the required-contexts reader) and render_md.mjs are imported by policy_lint.mjs and unowned. The data that decides verdicts is unowned too: policy_known_bad.json (the suppression ledger, whose 'may only shrink' is left to 'a reviewer'), policy_budgets.json and tests/structure_budgets.json (caps that CLAUDE.md rule 2 and ratchet-budgets.md say rise only with the owner's confirmation), corpus_excluded.json, cfr_exclusions.json, closures.json, both claim files and requirements-ci.txt.

findings.title: stop-selfcheck.sh lets a red policy corpus end a turn when the policy change is only staged
findings.claim: The real Stop hook exits 0 against a red linter in 2 of 4 policy-touching worktree states: a modified policy file that is `git add`ed, and a new policy file that is staged. Its CHANGED set unions only BASE...HEAD and the unstaged worktree diff.
findings.mechanism: `git diff --name-only` compares the worktree with the index, so a change already in the index appears in neither half of CHANGED, and touches_policy returns false. The hook's self-test drives only committed and unstaged changes.
